name: Himemiya Yuuri
source: A third-year at Ichijyoukan High School. His father is Russian and mother Japanese, and due to his feminine looks, he is often mistaken for a girl when he wears plain clothes. He considers [url=/c35847]Nana[/url] to be his rival because of the same twin-tailed hairstyle she wears.
